facts.fact: The National Communication Act, 2012 (Act No. 24) sets out in its Chapter XIII (ss. 73-83) the establishment of a Universal Service and Access Fund with a board of trustees, its financial resources and uses, and its annual budget, accounts and audit; only the chapter's section headings are in the capture, not the text, so the fund's sources of money are not stated here.

systems.owner: Established by the National Communication Act, 2012; supervised by the Ministry of ICT and Postal Services

note: Act date is the year only (2012, a proxy date); the fund's chapter text was not captured, so no sources of money or collection are stated; the Authority's own appropriations and licence fees (s.21) are other.
